method.name: IsInitialized
method.comment: Tests whether the object has been initialized.

method.name: _v5
method.comment: Returns the name of the system default printer.

method.name: _v6
method.comment: Returns a list of all installed printers on the system.

method.name: _initialize
method.comment: Initializes the object. You can add parameters to this method if needed.

method.name: _v7
method.comment: Prints a UI layout, form, or image using native JavaFX printing. Target: The object to print. Pass a layout root (B4XView) or an ImageView containing a bitmap. ShowDialog: True to show the system print dialog, False to print directly to the default printer. IsLandscape: True for landscape orientation, False for portrait. PaperSize: Standard paper size as a string (e.g., "A4", "A3", "LETTER", "LEGAL"). Top, Right, Bottom, Left: Margins in typographical points (72 points = 1 inch). Quality: Print quality level. Options: "HIGH", "NORMAL", "LOW", or "DRAFT". JobName: The name of the print job (used for the print queue or default PDF filename).

method.name: _v0
method.comment: Prints a UI layout, form, or image using a custom paper size (finds the closest match supported by the printer). Target: The object to print (B4XView or ImageView). ShowDialog: True to show the system print dialog, False to print directly to the default printer. IsLandscape: True for landscape orientation, False for portrait. PaperWidth, PaperHeight: Custom dimensions in points (1 mm = 2.83465 points). Top, Right, Bottom, Left: Margins in points. Quality: Print quality level ("HIGH", "NORMAL", "LOW", or "DRAFT"). JobName: The name of the print job.

method.name: _vv1
method.comment: Sets the printer to use by name before printing. Pass an empty string ("") to revert to the system default printer.

method.name: _vv2
method.comment: Takes a full high quality snapshot of B4XViews and returns a B4XBitmap. This method takes a higher quality snapshot than for example Root.Snapshot. Example: Snapshot(Root), or basically any other view. Uses slightly more memory for higher quality screenshots.
